claim: Ordinary forward DMA cannot implement an overlapping right shift; copy backward chunks through a scratch page or use a verified LDDR fallback.

evidence.text: Backward overlap uses a private scratch page; no DDMA extension is emitted; the verified LDDR fallback is the alternative.

N-Go board (Issue 2-compatible clone), core 3.03.00 (nxsuite D08): a forward memory-to-memory DMA with destination = source + 1 filled the block with the first byte (0 bytes wrong): forward overlap smears, it does not shift.
